Title: Swedish ECQ 2012 - TWD and small report

Messages.Author: Forhead
Messages.Body:
Greetings

extrala.blogspot.se/2012/04/results-gothcon-2012-draft-vtes.html
The Swedish ECQ took place during the biggest gaming convention in Sweden, GothCon. 34 players participated in this years draft event. We drafted 3 Lords of the night, 3 Third edition and 1 Dark Sovereignes (thanks to Hugh for bringing the display across the Narrow sea). The draft was won by Hugh Angseesing after a really tight 3 player game. I the 3 player game Pascal Bertrand just need one more stealth card to push his Reckless Agitation through (or Hugh would have need one less intercept card - depending on which point of view you have). Anyways cheers to Hugh for winning the draft!

extrala.blogspot.se/2012/04/results-swedish-ec-qualifier-2012.html
The second day of the Swedish ECQ 38 people from 8 different countries participated. We had a great day playing vtes and everyone was in a good mood. The finals were really tight and the very exciting. After and hour and a half Norbert plays an Anarcist Uprising that ousted Michael and Marko at the same time (Caroline was ousted two turns or so earlier) which resulted in Norbert and Adam entering the duel. Adam low on pool and 4-5 minions in play (some with Guns) and norbert having higher pool (10+ if I remember correctly) and only two minions with low blood. Adam starts by playing Pentex on Eze and Haven Uncovered on Nana Buruku. Rushing Nana and torporizing her. Norbert gets his turn contests Pentex and gets free and attempts to bleed. Eze only got one blood on him and Norbert can't afford the Strange Day he has on his hand when Adam play Second Tradtion. At this moment Norbert realizes that he can't win and congratualtes Adam on the tournament win.

A special thanks to:
Ralf Lammert for bring a nice piece of vtes art work with Liquefy the Mortal Coil as prize support (extrala.blogspot.se/2012/03/prize-support-2012.html).   Tiago Brum for bring me (or rather posting me) a rules bocklet sign by LSJ as prize support.   vtes.de for sending me a factory Sabbat War set as prize support.   Hugh Angseesing for bringing (as mentioned before) the box of Dark Sovereigns across The Narrow Sea.

And finally thanks to everyone who praticipated in the event - especially all of you that traveled from afar. I had a blast and would low to meet you all again for more vtes and just hanging out!

Some stats on the ECQ:
There were a total of 25 tables played Between the 5th finalist and the 11th player (highest non-qualified seed) there were only 1 vp There were 5 tables that timed out without a GW There were 3 tables with 2-2-1 splits 1/3 of the players that got a GW did not qualify Only 1 player got more then 1 GW 3 of the players in the ECQ final also played the draft final
This is, in my opinion, all indicators of a tournament were a lot of players were equal in skill and in how powerful their decks were. Which is both fun and great!
